developerNotes.title: No official claims
developerNotes.text: Offline checks never prove official Guatemala registry, tax, bank, postal, identity, or legal status.

developerNotes.title: Field breakdown required
developerNotes.text: Every tool must keep named slices visible because they are the primary debugging surface.

developerNotes.title: Same-country links
developerNotes.text: Related workbenches stay inside /guatemala/ unless a comparison route is explicitly designed.

commonMistakes.title: Treating syntax as status
commonMistakes.text: A passing shape check is not an official lookup result.

commonMistakes.title: Logging raw personal data
commonMistakes.text: Use masked previews for tickets, logs, analytics, and screenshots.

commonMistakes.title: Ignoring local separators
commonMistakes.text: Use Dot (.) and Comma (,) rules before API normalization.

commonMistakes.title: Mixing jurisdictions
commonMistakes.text: Do not reuse non-Guatemalan examples, fallback copy, or related links in this suite.
